provider: CUHK Department of Sociology Society and Sustainable Development curriculum and course listing
note: The CUHK 2026 admission page links the Department of Sociology's Society and Sustainable Development curriculum. That curriculum publishes a 61-unit path comprising 30 units of required Sociology courses, 15 units selected from a named Sociology pool, 7 units from Earth System Science and 9 units from a Diversity cluster. This supplement publishes the complete 33-code Sociology portion after merging SOCI4020, which appears both in the required list and as a conditionally eligible concentration course. Every included code and English title is also present in the current CUHK Sociology Course Listing, including SOCI2203, SOCI2219, SOCI3240 and SOCI3241, whose SSD annotations still refer to consideration in 2024-25. The public pages do not print per-course units or a recommended year/term beside these course rows, so credits, recommendedYear and semester remain unknown instead of being inferred from group totals. Earth System Science and Diversity-cluster rows are excluded until their current titles, units and alternative-code relationships are independently closed. This is a partial read-only planning list and must not produce a graduation completion percentage.
